title: Reading Drill — Soup made from Surplus Vegetables
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: Soup made from Surplus Vegetables
passages.body:
**A** A community kitchen received a different mix of vegetables each day. To avoid promising an ingredient it might not receive, the cook printed a menu board that could be edited shortly before the kitchen opened.

**B** The soup recipe specified a target thickness instead of a fixed amount of water. A volunteer measured each batch in the same jug and added liquid only when the mixture was too thick to pour.

**C** The kitchen tracked leftovers. When it saw that large portions were often unfinished, it offered a smaller bowl with the option of a refill, so diners could decide how much to eat.
